capabilities.title: Azure control-plane collection
capabilities.scope: Subscription-first collector, subject to Azure RBAC and Graph permissions.
limitations: Does not inventory all Azure services or establish endpoint compliance.
Historical live assessments need scoped provenance review before admission to this register.

capabilities.title: AWS control-plane collection
limitations: Provider metadata remains research_preview; fake-client tests do not promote it to active.

capabilities.title: Provider evidence contracts
capabilities.scope: Per-control support, permissions, freshness and sufficiency declarations.
limitations: Declared contracts are not proof that every permission or provider API has been exercised.

capabilities.title: Validated control metadata
capabilities.scope: Schema, registry and evaluator alignment for the baseline control pack.
limitations: Structural checks do not establish rule correctness or assessor approval.

capabilities.title: Decision provenance
capabilities.scope: Inspectable links between assessment decisions and their recorded evidence.
limitations: Traceability does not independently establish the truth or sufficiency of source evidence.

capabilities.title: Budget-aware remediation planning
capabilities.scope: Heuristic prioritization and budget-constrained remediation scenarios.
limitations: Estimated effort and simulated benefits are not measured customer savings or incident-risk reduction.

limitations: Does not certify Cyber Essentials or replace an assessor.

capabilities.title: Opt-in authenticated enterprise backend
capabilities.scope: Versioned bearer-token API, PostgreSQL memberships and fenced jobs, connection onboarding and tenant-scoped artifact downloads.

live_observations.scope: Real browser PKCE, signed-token validation and PostgreSQL membership/tenant/role denial paths only; no cloud assessment.
live_observations.environment: Controlled local Keycloak 26.8.1, PostgreSQL 16.15 and Chromium; private localhost CA and loopback APIs.

limitations: Fixture tests and one controlled local Keycloak integration do not establish customer-cloud or public production qualification.
The local runner remains outside this authenticated API; the separate opt-in enterprise console does not approve shared hosting.
Managed blob storage, customer consent UX, independent security review and production release gates remain open.

capabilities.title: Opt-in authenticated enterprise browser console
capabilities.scope: OIDC code-flow PKCE sign-in, organization/run-scoped report views, cloud connection administration, authorized scan lifecycle and integrity-checked artifact downloads.

live_observations.scope: Real browser PKCE, signed-token validation and PostgreSQL membership/tenant/role denial paths only; no cloud assessment.
live_observations.environment: Controlled local Keycloak 26.8.1, PostgreSQL 16.15 and Chromium; private localhost CA and loopback APIs.

limitations: Browser fixtures are supplemented by one controlled local Keycloak/API/PostgreSQL observation, not public production or customer-cloud qualification.
Session tokens use tab-local sessionStorage; no BFF, federated Azure onboarding, automatic token renewal or IdP-wide logout is supplied.
Public-exposure enterprise workflows, historical local report import, managed blob storage and production review remain open.
